verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਉਪਮਾ ਉਪਮਾ ਕਰੈ ਉਪਮਾ ਨ ਵਖਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: lakh upamaa upamaa karai upamaa na vakhaanai|

en.bdb: People praise the Guru through millions of ways and to do so take help of many comparisons.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕਰੈ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਹੈਰਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: lakh mahimaa mahimaa karai mahimaa hairaanai|

en.bdb: Millions of people eulogise so much that even the eulogy feels wonder struck.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਮਹਾਤਮ ਮਹਾਤਮਾ ਨ ਮਹਾਤਮੁ ਜਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: lakh mahaatam mahaatamaa na mahaatam jaanai|

en.bdb: Millions of spiritualists explain the grandeur of Guru but they do not understand the same.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨ ਸਿਞਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: lakh usatat usatat karai usatat na sin(j)aanai|

en.bdb: Millions of eulogisers recite praise s but they do not understand the real praise.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਹੈ ਮੈਂ ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੈ ॥੨੨॥
verses.translit_en: aadh purakh aadhes hai mai(n) maan nimaanai ||22||

en.bdb: I respectfully bow before such a primeval Lord who is the pride of the humble person like me.
